resolved_intermediate_risk.description: The >=32-only gate can initialize O(V) storage for many fixed-small-fanin joins. Parent found this before timing. Intermediate functional differential passed and its evidence is preserved separately; no final or performance pass is assigned to05e.
resolved_intermediate_risk.resolution: 59d requires pred.len() >=32 AND pred.len() >=ceil(V/4). Initialization and chain/trail traversal cost is O(V), bounded by four times that block total predecessor-edge count per merge. Sparse joins keep prior intersect; no whole-CHK linear claim.

static_invariants: Within each merge idom is immutably borrowed, and all passed predecessors have known idom. Existing CHK rank/initialization maintains a rooted acyclic current-parent relation. No projection is shared across blocks, iterations or requests.

The first predecessor ancestor chain is explicitly marked; each newly visited path is assigned its unique first intersection on that chain. All intersections lie on one ordered chain, so minimal RPO rank selects the common ancestor for all processed predecessors. Root early exit is absorbing.

Both sparse and dense branches preserve predecessor filtering and block/update ordering. They return the same immediate-dominator result; all reachable and idom entries, including MAX unreachable sentinels, were compared directly against801.

HashMap replaces only local defs/labels identity lookup; definitions/instructions/block traversal remain source ordered. The sole labels.keys scan computes an existence predicate with one fixed diagnostic. Global symbol/type maps, returned schedules and ordering structures remain ordered.
